changeSet.author: taurus
changeSet.comment: Position of the instrument in the ensemble of the band, from 1 without gaps; empty for instruments outside the ensemble and for deleted ones. Uniqueness is checked at the end of the transaction, so a new order can be written one instrument at a time.

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE instrument DROP CONSTRAINT uq_instrument_ensemble_position; ALTER TABLE instrument DROP CONSTRAINT ck_instrument_ensemble_position;
